metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean pairwise cosine of sampled base item embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. 0.5 means mean cosine zero. Higher means greater directional alignment; this does not establish collapse, recommendation diversity, or compatibility. Null means fewer than two catalog items.
metric_definitions.margin_valid_positions: Number of valid sampled training positions; zero means margin summaries are unavailable.
metric_definitions.sampled_logit_std: Population standard deviation of positive and negative logits on the first usable diagnostic batch; score scale, not validation accuracy. Null means unavailable.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts valid sampled training positions with margin<eps or margin<0. Category lists are empty because item categories are unavailable. Sampled training margins do not estimate validation HR@10 or full-catalog accuracy.
